verdict.rationale: Agent-readable documentation is a fair axis for a package manager with public docs, but the probes found no llms.txt (404), no markdown docs variant (404) and no OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404). The registry API docs do exist as raw markdown on GitHub, but they are ordinary human-oriented documentation, not an agent-oriented entry point, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
